# Figure 1D, F, H

```{r}
data<-read.csv("../rawdata/Quantifications/qPCR_data.csv")
```

```{r}
bar_color  <- "#4DBBD5"
point_size <- 0.5
out_dir    <- "../Figures"

genes_keep <- c("FOXA2", "GBX2", "NKX2.2", "OTX2")
cmp <- list(c("D0","D12"), c("D12","D17"), c("D17","D24"))

ddct_df <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target.Name = toupper(trimws(Target.Name)),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("D0", "D12", "D17", "D24"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Target.Name != "18S", !is.na(dCt), !is.na(Treatment)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Target.Name, sheet) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dCt_ref_D0 = mean(dCt[Treatment == "D0"], na.rm = TRUE),
    ddCt       = dCt - dCt_ref_D0,
    FC         = 2^(-ddCt)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


dfp <- ddct_df %>%
  mutate(
    Target.Name = toupper(trimws(Target.Name)),
    Treatment = factor(as.character(Treatment),
                       levels = c("D0","D12","D17","D24"))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Target.Name %in% genes_keep,
    is.finite(FC),
    !is.na(sheet)
  ) %>%
  mutate(log2FC = log2(FC))

stat_df <- dfp %>%
  group_by(Target.Name) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(log2FC ~ Treatment, comparisons = cmp) %>%
  rstatix::adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  rstatix::add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  left_join(
    dfp %>%
      group_by(Target.Name) %>%
      summarise(
        fc_min = min(FC, na.rm = TRUE),
        fc_max = max(FC, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = "Target.Name"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Target.Name) %>%
  mutate(step = (fc_max - fc_min) * 0.06) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = max(
      dfp$FC[dfp$Target.Name == Target.Name &
               dfp$Treatment %in% c(group1, group2)],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) + step * row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

sci_lab_expr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  out <- vector("list", length(x))

  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    v <- x[i]
    if (!is.finite(v)) {
      out[[i]] <- NA
    } else if (v == 0) {
      out[[i]] <- 0
    } else if (abs(v) < 100) {
      out[[i]] <- v
    } else {
      e <- floor(log10(abs(v)))
      m <- signif(v / 10^e, 2)
      out[[i]] <- bquote(.(m) %*% 10^.(e))
    }
  }

  as.expression(out)
}

make_gene_plot <- function(g) {

  d <- dfp %>% filter(Target.Name == g)
  s <- stat_df %>% filter(Target.Name == g)

  y_top <- max(c(d$FC, s$y.position), na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lim <- y_top * 1.12


  brks <- scales::breaks_extended(n = 4)(c(0, y_lim))
  brks <- brks[is.finite(brks) & brks >= 0 & brks <= y_lim]
  brks <- sort(unique(brks))
  if (length(brks) == 0) brks <- c(0, y_lim)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = Treatment, y = FC)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = bar_color, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(aes(shape = sheet),
                width = 0.12, height = 0, size = point_size) +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      s, label = "p.adj.signif", tip.length = 0.01, hide.ns = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_lim),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02)),
      breaks = brks,
      labels = sci_lab_expr(brks),
      minor_breaks = NULL
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(1, "pt"),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "mm")
    )
}

plots <- setNames(lapply(genes_keep, make_gene_plot), genes_keep)

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

for (g in genes_keep) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(g, "_FC_boxplot.png")),
    plot = plots[[g]],
    width = 29, height = 24, units = "mm",
    dpi = 600
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(g, "_FC_boxplot.pdf")),
    plot = plots[[g]],
    width = 29, height = 24, units = "mm"
  )
}

```

```{r}
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0(g, "_FC_boxplot_noY_22mm.pdf")),

    width = 22, height = 24, units = "mm"

}
```

# Figure 1C

```{r}
data<-read_excel("../rawdata/Quantifications/RO_QUANTIFICATION.xlsx", sheet=1)
data_pct <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pct_OTX2  = 100 * (`OTX2+`  / CELLS),
    pct_HOXB2 = 100 * (`HOBX2+` / CELLS)
  )

# long format
plot_df <- data_pct %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(pct_OTX2, pct_HOXB2),
    names_to = "marker",
    values_to = "percent"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    marker = dplyr::recode(marker,
      pct_OTX2  = "OTX2+",
      pct_HOXB2 = "HOXB2+"
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = marker, y = percent, fill = marker)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(aes(shape = LINE), width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_fill_manual(values= c("#4EBF25", "#EC008C")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/Figure1C.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 24,
  height = 24,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 600
)
```

# Figure 4B

```{r}
data<-read_excel("../rawdata/Quantifications/RO_QUANTIFICATION.xlsx", sheet="FUSION")

df <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition, "5-HT" = "5HT+"),
    Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition, "NO" = "5HT-"),
    Batch = as.factor(BATCH),
    Line = as.factor(LINE),
    Picture = as.factor(PICTURE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(`pH3 loop / total pH3`),
    !is.na(Condition),
    !is.na(Batch),
    !is.na(Line),
    !is.na(Picture)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Line, Batch, Condition, Picture) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    perc = mean(`pH3 loop / total pH3`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Condition = factor(Condition)
  )


stat.test <- df %>%
  rstatix::pairwise_wilcox_test(
    perc ~ Condition,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Condition") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = paste0("p.adj = ", signif(p.adj, 2))
  )
stat.test$y.position=1.8

my_hex <- "#4DBBD5"

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Condition, y = perc)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = my_hex, outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(shape = Batch),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 0.6,
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "label",
    size = 4 / 2.845,
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
    axis.title.y=element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  ylab("pH3 loop / total pH3 (%)")

ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/Figure4B.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 24, height = 28, units = "mm",
  dpi = 600
)
```


# Figure 4F

```{r}
data <- read_excel("../rawdata/Quantifications/RO_QUANTIFICATION.xlsx", sheet = "5HT-SVZ-bRG")

df <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Condition = dplyr::recode(
      Condition,
      "5-HT" = "5HT",
      "Ket+5-HT" = "Ket+5HT"
    ),
    perc = (pH3 / SOX2) * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(perc), !is.na(Condition), !is.na(Batch), !is.na(number)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Condition, Batch, number) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    perc = mean(perc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Batch = as.factor(Batch),
    number = as.factor(number),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("DMSO", "5HT", "TCB2", "Ket+5HT"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Condition, Batch, number, perc)

stat.test <- df %>%
  rstatix::pairwise_wilcox_test(
    perc ~ Condition,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Condition", step.increase = 0.2)

stat.test$y.position<-c(17, 19.5, 21.5, 23.7)
stat.test <- stat.test %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = paste0("p.adj = ", signif(p.adj, 2))
  )

my_hex <- "#4DBBD5"

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Condition, y = perc)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = my_hex, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(shape = Batch),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 0.5,
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "label",
    size = 4 / 2.845,
    tip.length = 0.01
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylab("% pH3 / SOX2")

p_out <- p +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 25), clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line.x = element_line(),
    axis.line.y = element_line()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/Figure4F.png",
  plot = p_out,
  width = 35, height = 26, units = "mm",
  dpi = 600
)
```

# Figure 4H

```{r}
data <- read_excel("../rawdata/Quantifications/RO_QUANTIFICATION.xlsx", sheet = "5HT-SVZ-IP")

df_org <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Condition = dplyr::recode(Condition, "5-HT" = "5HT"),
    Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c("DMSO", "5HT")),
    Batch = as.factor(Batch),
    PIC = as.factor(IMAGE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Condition %in% c("DMSO", "5HT"),
    !is.na(TBR2),
    !is.na(pH3),
    !is.na(Batch),
    !is.na(PIC)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Batch, PIC, Condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Nuclei = sum(TBR2, na.rm = TRUE),
    pH3 = sum(pH3, na.rm = TRUE),
    perc = 100 * pH3 / Nuclei,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_org %>%
  dplyr::count(Batch, PIC, Condition) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

stat.test <- df_org %>%
  rstatix::pairwise_wilcox_test(
    perc ~ Condition,
    paired = FALSE,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Condition") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0("p.adj = ", signif(p.adj, 2)))

my_hex <- "#4DBBD5"

p <- ggplot(df_org, aes(x = Condition, y = perc)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = my_hex, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(shape = Batch),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 0.5,
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat.test,
    label = "label",
    size = 4 / 2.845,
    tip.length = 0.01,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3), clip = "off") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% pH3 / TBR2") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.line.x = element_line(),
    axis.line.y = element_line()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/Figure4H.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 35, height = 26, units = "mm",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
